PlayerProfile.title: PlayerProfile
PlayerProfile.description: Single-document quota-optimized player profile and Paper Craft Crush saga progress.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the player.

username.description: Player chosen username or GM handle (e.g., jcv).

role.description: Account role: standard player or Game Master (gm).

highestUnlockedLevel.description: Highest unlocked level on the Paper Craft Trail (1 to 50).

highScore.description: All-time highest score achieved by the player.

starsEncoded.description: Compact encoded string of level star ratings (e.g., '1:3,2:3') to avoid multi-document reads/writes.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last synced (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user quota-optimized profile document storing account identity, GM role, and full 50-level saga progress in a single document.
